prusalink.created: Copy the API key now. It works for every printer you may operate, so you can paste the same key for each of them. This server keeps only its hash and does not show it again. It is listed under Settings, API credentials, where you can revoke it.
prusalink.plainHttp: This address is plain HTTP, so the key crosses your network unencrypted. Where the server has an HTTPS address, paste that one into PrusaSlicer instead.
prusalink.steps.title: How to set up PrusaSlicer
prusalink.steps.add: Use PrusaSlicer 2.4 or later. Next to the printer profile, click Add physical printer.
prusalink.steps.host: Set Host Type to PrusaLink and paste the address into Hostname, IP or URL.
prusalink.steps.key: Set Authorization Type to API key and paste the API key.
prusalink.keep.title: Uploads from PrusaSlicer
prusalink.keep.elsewhere: Uploads go to a storage you may not write to. Choosing a folder keeps them there.
prusalink.keep.readOnlyOn: Uploads to this printer are saved to storage.
prusalink.keep.readOnlyOff: Not saved to storage. The file goes to the printer and is then deleted from this server.
prusalink.keep.readOnlyNote: Only a person who may operate this printer changes this.
prusalink.keep.scope: Applies to every upload from PrusaSlicer to this printer, whoever sends it.
prusalink.keep.readOnlyNobody: Nobody may change this until the administrator grants the extension its operate check.
howTo.title: How to
howTo.perPrinter: PrusaSlicer 2 Connector is set up for each printer, not for the server. Each printer has its own address and its own card.
howTo.steps.open: Open a printer's page and its Printer tab. The PrusaSlicer 2 Connector card is under the Connection card.
howTo.steps.copy: Copy the address and create an API key on that card.
howTo.steps.slicer: In PrusaSlicer 2.4 or later, click Add physical printer. Set Host Type to PrusaLink and paste the address, set Authorization Type to API key and paste the key, then click Test.
howTo.steps.more: Do the same for each printer. One key works for every printer you may operate.
howTo.keep: Save to storage is on the same card. It is one setting for that printer, and applies to every upload from PrusaSlicer to it, whoever sends it.
howTo.limits: The largest upload is set for the whole server, on the Uploads tab.
